title: Explain a zero replenishment quantity
steps: Review the Computer XP4523 row in the loaded physical-stock list, then hover over its To order quantity.

video_guide.summary: Inspect the first stock row: it is below desired stock, yet To order is zero and hovering provides no explanation.

chapters.note: Computer XP4523 has desired stock 200, physical stock 110 and 100 already ordered.
Its To order field is zero even though the product remains on the replenishment list.

chapters.label: Hover the zero To order quantity

chapters.note: The pointer is over the zero quantity, but no contextual explanation is displayed.
